description: Source code implementing Bluetooth cryptographic functions, including PRNG initialization, reseeding, and AES encryption, using TinyCrypt library within Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: prng_reseed
methods.description: Reseeds the HMAC-PRNG with a new seed and extra entropy.

methods.name: prng_init
methods.description: Initializes the PRNG with a random seed and reseeds it.

methods.name: bt_rand
methods.description: Generates random bytes using PRNG or HCI command based on configuration.

methods.name: bt_encrypt_le
methods.description: Performs AES-128 encryption in little-endian mode.

methods.name: bt_encrypt_be
methods.description: Performs AES-128 encryption in big-endian mode.

methods.name: bt_crypto_get_hmac_prng_instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the HMAC-PRNG (for unit testing).
